description: Leverage analysis for a Longbow multiply: borrow USDG against WETH collateral, swap it for more WETH on Uniswap V4, post it as collateral — one atomic bundle, no flash loan. Returns whether it is feasible at the 1.15 health-factor floor, the maximum borrow, the swap quote, the resulting health factor, liquidation price, and leverage. Read-only; the prepare tool is gated until the legal review is complete.

address.description: Wallet address, to include its existing collateral and debt in the plan.

amount.description: Same in USDG base units (6 decimals). Use instead of borrowAmountUsdg.

borrowAmountUsdg.description: USDG to borrow, as a decimal such as 100.

collateralAmount.description: Same in WETH base units (18 decimals). Use instead of collateralAmountEth.

collateralAmountEth.description: New WETH collateral to post, as a decimal such as 0.1. Omit it to borrow against collateral already posted.

market.description: Market key (ETH, NVDA, SPY), symbol, name, or marketId. Multiply needs a WETH-collateral market.

slippageBps.description: Slippage limit in basis points. Default 100, maximum 1000.

name: polypad_longbow_plan_multiply
title: Plan a Longbow multiply
